description: Builds one provider’s sign-up link for a chosen plan. Returns links.getStarted, the sign-up URL for that plan, including its query parameters, and the plan the link was built for when one matches.

currently_taking_glp1.description: Whether the person already takes a GLP-1. Starter packs are for new patients. When this is omitted, a starter plan can appear among the results.

dosage_mg.description: Weekly dose in mg the price was quoted for.

drug.description: Molecule the plan is for: semaglutide or tirzepatide.

months.description: Plan length in months, when plan_type does not already state it.

plan_type.description: Plan the price was quoted for: monthly, a prepaid 3, 6 or 12-month plan, a starter pack, a step-up plan or a microdose plan.

provider.description: Provider name, slug or numeric GLP Winner id.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code ("TX") or a full name ("Texas"). Which providers are available, and some prices, depend on the state.

name: get_glp1_signup_link
title: Get a sign-up link
